intro: Wednesday brings another coding-agent integration, open tests for AI reliability and a police warning about electric dirt bikes. Plan ahead for robotics discussions, Mediterranean music and piano with brain imagery, while a theatre-linked menu starts today.

stories.title: Copilot enters JetBrains Air’s agent picker
stories.summary: GitHub Copilot now handles local and cloud coding tasks through JetBrains Air using an existing Copilot subscription. Install Air and connect an account for local work; cloud tasks additionally require an Air Teams business organization and administrator enablement.

stories.title: CodeQL adds Python 3.15 and an AI threat model
stories.summary: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 syntax, C23 bit-precise integers and JSON data extensions. Its optional AI threat model lets teams define sources for language-model-generated data; maintainers with custom GitHub Actions queries should review breaking control-flow changes.

stories.title: StateBench tests whether models follow changing facts
stories.summary: Ai2 released StateBench to measure how language models track entities and changing information across long documents. Public data and code separate simple retrieval from chains of updates, helping developers test capabilities that an advertised context-window size does not establish.

stories.title: CWE-bench opens 100 security-repair tasks
stories.summary: CWE-bench v2 makes 100 defensive coding tasks covering 91 weakness categories available for public evaluation. Agents must repair real open-source repositories without breaking existing functionality, with programmatic graders giving developers a reproducible way to compare security performance.

stories.title: Halloween collision prompts electric dirt-bike warning
stories.summary: Vancouver police say a 15-year-old suffered minor injuries after allegedly running stop signs and colliding with a vehicle in Kerrisdale. The investigation continues; police remind riders that most electric dirt bikes are designed for off-road use and prohibited on public streets.

stories.title: Macklem tells MPs energy costs threaten broader inflation
stories.summary: Tiff Macklem told the Commons finance committee Tuesday that persistent Middle East conflict has worsened Canada’s inflation outlook through higher oil prices. He said economic resilience and the risk of energy costs spreading justified last week’s interest-rate increase.

events.date: 2026-11-12 · 7:30 p.m. · Fox Cabaret, 2321 Main Street, Vancouver
events.title: Duo Andalus brings voice and guitar to Chutzpah
events.description: LALA Tamar and Ofer Ronen connect Mediterranean and North African musical traditions through songs and stories, including Moroccan Ladino heritage. Their intimate voice-and-strings performance begins at 7:30; doors open at seven, with advance tickets available through the festival’s listing.

events.date: 2026-11-28 · 3 p.m. · The ANNEX Theatre, 823 Seymour Street, Vancouver
events.title: Neurorecital gives piano music a visual counterpart
events.description: Nicolas Namoradze performs selections by Bach, Debussy and Scriabin alongside synchronized imagery derived from EEG recordings of his playing. Muzewest’s two-hour afternoon event connects musical interpretation with brain activity; individual tickets are available through the organizer’s Showpass listing.

meetups.date: 2026-11-12 · Doane Grant Thornton LLP, Floor 29 (Sky Lounge), 733 Seymour Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: HardTech Forum examines the decision to buy robots
meetups.description: MistyWest and Robot Sales Club gather manufacturing and logistics practitioners to discuss robotics adoption, integration and investment. The discussion considers buying existing systems, waiting for technology to mature or building internally; the registration listing offers tickets for $30.

meetups.date: 2026-12-16 · H.R. MacMillan Space Centre, 1100 Chestnut Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: December’s Vancouver AI evening opens registration
meetups.description: Builders, researchers, artists and students can exchange tools, demonstrate work and compare practical AI questions at the monthly gathering. Doors open at six, the program starts at seven and the evening ends by ten; speakers and theme remain unannounced.
